params.message:
Take up mail in the Portal inbox and notify refused mail

Portal now keeps mail that names no project (state unassigned) and a notice
for refused mail, instead of dropping both.

- mail-intake starts one agent per inbox mail with the task to find the
  project in PROJECTS.md first: assign it when one project is clearly
  meant, park it with one question to the owner when in doubt.
- mail.mjs assign <id> <slug> sends portal.task with state "assign" under
  the project's slug, then prints the usual task for that project's mail,
  so the same agent carries on as with any forwarded mail.
- mail.mjs state moves an inbox mail under the slug Portal names
  (taskProject); list and show say when a mail is in the inbox.
- A refused mail gives one herdr notification with the sender's domain and
  the reason; the journal only says a notice was shown.
- The task texts and the PROJECTS.md parser move to lib/intake.mjs, with
  tests; the parser no longer reads the header and separator rows as
  projects.
- A list Portal does not know yet (422 before the Portal change is
  deployed) is skipped, so new mail still starts.
